$comment: WS3 capability-resolution rules. Source of truth for search order and thresholds; resolve.py loads this at import. Generation is deliberately absent from search_order: an ACTION_GAP resolves to an existing capability or to MANUFACTURING_GAP, never to code generation.

search_order.source: chains of local actions whose postconditions satisfy the next preconditions, depth<=max_chain_depth
sentinel; schedule manufacturing work (new pack / ontology individual), route_to_codegen is always false

domination: c1 dominates c2 iff rank(c1)<=rank(c2) and score(c1)>=score(c2) and depth(c1)<=depth(c2) with at least one strict; non-dominated candidates are all retained in candidates[]
